summary: RIYADH — Saudi security authorities arrested a total of 11,587 illegal residents in a week. The arrests were made in the joint inspections, carried out by the security forces in collaboration with the relevant government agencies, during the period between October 29 and November 4, the Ministry of Interior announced on Saturday. Those who were arrested include 6,043 violators of the Residency Law, 3,191 violators of the Border Security Law, and 2,353 violators of the Labor Law. summary: بنیامین نتانیاهو، نخست‌وزیر اسرائیل، شنبه ۱۶ آبان در پیامی ویدیویی با هشدار درباره تشکیل دولتی متکی به حمایت احزاب عرب، خواستار تشکیل دولت وحدت ملی با مشارکت همه احزاب «اردوگاه ملی» و احزاب صهیونیستی شد و گفت چنین دولتی تهدید هسته‌ای جمهوری اسلامی را برای همیشه از میان خواهد برد.

title: Saudi citizen arrested for transporting 8 border security violators in Jazan
summary: RIYADH — Security Regiments patrols in Al-Dair governorate in the southern Jazan region arrested a Saudi citizen for transporting eight border security violators in a vehicle he was driving.All the violators were taken into custody, and legal procedures were taken against them. title: Saudi, Egyptian and Qatari foreign ministers discuss regional de-escalation in phone call
summary: RIYADH — Saudi Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan received on Saturday a phone call from Egypt’s Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation and Egyptian Expatriates Dr. Badr Abdelatty. During the call, they discussed regional and international developments and efforts to support security and stability. Prince Faisal bin also held a phone call with Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs of Qatar Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani. During the call, they discussed the latest regional developments and efforts to de-escalate tensions and strengthen security and stability.

items.title: Saudi, Egyptian and Qatari foreign ministers discuss regional de-escalation in phone call
